Do you want to provide droidfood feedback for Face Unlock? We need data from a diverse set of users using the feature in real-world scenarios to make sure our Face Unlock works equally well for all our users.\n\nIf you volunteer to participate, data collected from unlock attempts (e.g. facial imagery) will be made available in the preinstalled Overlay data collection app. Your facial imagery data will be uploaded to and shared with Google ONLY upon your review and explicit consent in the Overlay app. Model performance metadata from unlock attempts will be collected via Android metrics.

You and your child can delete their face model or turn off Face Unlock at any time in Settings. Face models are stored on the phone until they’re deleted.
You can delete your face model or turn off Face Unlock at any time in Settings. Face models are stored on the phone until you delete them.

Face Unlock creates a unique model of your child’s face to verify it’s them. To create this face model during setup, your child will take images of their face from different angles.\n\nWhen they use Face Unlock, images are used to update their face model. Images used to create their face model are never stored, but the face model is stored securely on the phone and never leaves the phone. All processing occurs securely on the phone.
